# tracing its imports; an editable install's .pth redirect into src/backend
# isn't something that tracing follows, which risks src/backend/*.py being
# left out of the deployed bundle. api/index.py puts `src` on sys.path
# directly instead, and vercel.json's `includeFiles` bundles it explicitly.
